name: Summarize customer feedback into themes
outcome: Free-text customer feedback across surveys, reviews and support channels becomes themes with representative quotes and counts a leader can act on.
description: Collected first-party feedback, such as survey verbatims, product reviews, support and sales notes, and NPS or CSAT comments, is grouped into recurring themes, each with representative quotes and a count or share, so a leader sees what customers raise most without reading every comment. Distinct from mkt.monitor-brand-mentions, which watches unsolicited public mentions rather than collected feedback; from cs.summarize-conversations, which recaps one conversation for the next handler rather than aggregating many; and from hr.summarize-engagement-feedback, which does the same for employees rather than customers.
measures: theme accuracy rated by the team
share of feedback mapped to a theme
